<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Snake Game</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background-color: #2f2f2f;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        canvas {
            border: 1px solid #444;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="snake-canvas" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('snake-canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let snake = [
            {x: 200, y: 200},
            {x: 190, y: 200},
            {x: 180, y: 200}
        ];
        let direction = 'right';
        let score = 0;
        let food = {x: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10, y: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10};
        function draw() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            for (let i = 0; i < snake.length; i++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(snake[i].x, snake[i].y, 10, 10);
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)';
            ctx.fillRect(food.x, food.y, 10, 10);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
            ctx.font = '24px Inter';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 10);
        }
        function update() {
            for (let i = snake.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                snake[i] = { ...snake[i - 1] };
            }
            if (direction === 'right') {
                snake[0].x += 10;
            } else if (direction === 'left') {
                snake[0].x -= 10;
            } else if (direction === 'up') {
                snake[0].y -= 10;
            } else if (direction === 'down') {
                snake[0].y += 10;
            }
            if (snake[0].x === food.x && snake[0].y === food.y) {
                score++;
                food = {x: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10, y: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10};
                snake.push({x: snake[snake.length - 1].x, y: snake[snake.length - 1].y});
            }
            if (snake[0].x < 0 || snake[0].x >= canvas.width || snake[0].y < 0 || snake[0].y >= canvas.height || snake.slice(1).some((segment) => segment.x === snake[0].x && segment.y === snake[0].y)) {
                alert(`Game Over! Final Score: ${score}`);
                snake = [
                    {x: 200, y: 200},
                    {x: 190, y: 200},
                    {x: 180, y: 200}
                ];
                direction = 'right';
                score = 0;
                food = {x: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10, y: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10};
            }
        }
        function handleKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'd') {
                direction = 'right';
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'a') {
                direction = 'left';
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp' || event.key === 'w') {
                direction = 'up';
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 's') {
                direction = 'down';
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
        setInterval(() => {
            update();
            draw();
        }, 100);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Cyber Highway Racing</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background-color: #2f2f2f;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        canvas {
            border: 1px solid #444;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="racing-canvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('racing-canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let player = {x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 50, speed: 5};
        let highway = [];
        let obstacles = [];
        let speedBoosters = [];
        let score = 0;
        let distance = 0;
        function draw() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            for (let i = 0; i < highway.length; i++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(highway[i].x, highway[i].y, 10, 10);
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)';
            ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, 20, 20);
            for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(obstacles[i].x, obstacles[i].y, 20, 20);
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < speedBoosters.length; i++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(speedBoosters[i].x, speedBoosters[i].y, 20, 20);
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
            ctx.font = '24px Inter';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 10);
            ctx.fillText(`Distance: ${distance}m`, 10, 40);
        }
        function update() {
            player.y -= player.speed;
            distance += player.speed;
            if (player.y < 0) {
                player.y = canvas.height - 50;
            }
            for (let i = highway.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                highway[i].y += 5;
                if (highway[i].y > canvas.height) {
                    highway.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
            for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                obstacles[i].y += 5;
                if (obstacles[i].y > canvas.height) {
                    obstacles.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
            for (let i = speedBoosters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                speedBoosters[i].y += 5;
                if (speedBoosters[i].y > canvas.height) {
                    speedBoosters.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
            if (Math.random() < 0.1) {
                highway.push({x: Math.floor(Math.random() * (canvas.width - 10)), y: 0});
            }
            if (Math.random() < 0.05) {
                obstacles.push({x: Math.floor(Math.random() * (canvas.width - 20)), y: 0});
            }
            if (Math.random() < 0.01) {
                speedBoosters.push({x: Math.floor(Math.random() * (canvas.width - 20)), y: 0});
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                if (checkCollision(player, obstacles[i])) {
                    alert(`Game Over! Final Score: ${score}`);
                    player = {x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 50, speed: 5};
                    highway = [];
                    obstacles = [];
                    speedBoosters = [];
                    score = 0;
                    distance = 0;
                }
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < speedBoosters.length; i++) {
                if (checkCollision(player, speedBoosters[i])) {
                    player.speed += 2;
                    speedBoosters.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
        }
        function checkCollision(obj1, obj2) {
            if (obj1.x + 20 > obj2.x && obj1.x < obj2.x + 20 && obj1.y + 20 > obj2.y && obj1.y < obj2.y + 20) {
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function handleKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'a') {
                player.x -= 10;
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'd') {
                player.x += 10;
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
        setInterval(() => {
            update();
            draw();
        }, 16);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
